facts.title: audit finding - work clearance records incomplete for TK-4210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control HOT_WORK_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of hot work adjacent to live plant was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch on TK-4210 and PSV-4210 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on TK-4210 and PSV-4210 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising hot work, specifically providing and briefing a fire watch. TK-4210 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 18 December 2009 a planned spot check of TK-4210 and PSV-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch not effective.
